Open House on July 19th @1:30-4:30pm. Please text Freda upon arrival at the lobby. 
Modern 2BR/2BA Condo with Stunning City and tranquil courtyard views.
Welcome to 250 King St., #880, a beautifully updated 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo in the heart of Mission Bay. Perched on the 8th floor and overlooking the Beacon's courtyard/swimming pool, this home is very quiet , full of natural lights, offers ideal split-bedroom floorplan (two on each end with living room in the middle) for privacy and comfort and easy access to vibrant Mission Bay neighborhood.

Enjoy hardwood flooring throughout the unit, a bright and spacious living area with oversized windows, and a modern kitchen featuring white cabinetry, granite countertops, and stainless steel appliances. Both bedrooms include custom closets; updated bathrooms, and in-unit washer/dryer. One underground parking spot is included (Price is negotiable if no parking needed).

Residents at The Beacon enjoy resort-style amenities, including 24-hour doorman/security, outdoor pool, two hot tubs, a fitness center with sauna, a clubhouse with a chef's kitchen, a business center, and a dog run. 

Perfectly situated across from Oracle Park and connected to Safeway (same building) , this home offers easy access to tech HQs, cafes and restaurants, MUNI Caltrain, I280, UCSF campus, Chase Center, Financial District, and more. Experience the best of city living at The Beacon!

Owner pays for water and trash, the rest shall be paid by tenants. One garage parking spot is included for tenant's own use only. Renter is responsible for move-in/out fee payable directly due to the front desk. Minimum one year lease.
